_note: One-time backfill (2026-10-15, design v4 W1): screen-level lessons (ids, control behaviour) converted from run friction notes, live looks and LIVE_FINDINGS.md, plus stated field rules. Read by build_screen_file.py on every build and merged into the screen files (deduplicated by text). Business rules are NOT here: they live in the business pages and need QA confirmation. New lessons go straight into the screen file's lessons[] (the builder keeps them).

lessons.text: Off Days is a DevExtreme tag box (multi-select) on cnr1dev1: input id DDL__epp1_offdays, placeholder 'Select...', options Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday, Saturday, Sunday in that order; no 'Select all', no checkboxes.
Off Days list closes after every pick: for each day, real-click the input to reopen the list, wait for the visible .dx-list-item, then real-click it. Hidden list items are not interactable.
Off Days: choosing a day that is already selected removes it (the pick toggles the tag off).

Off Days tags are not inside #DDL__epp1_offdays (that id is the tag box input): read them from the parent tag box, document.getElementById('DDL__epp1_offdays').closest('.dx-tagbox').querySelectorAll('.dx-tag').

Off Days cross-out: real click on the .dx-tag-remove-button of the tag, e.g. //div[contains(@class,'dx-tag-content') and normalize-space()='Friday']/*[contains(@class,'dx-tag-remove-button')]. The watcher logs it as a click on div.dx-tag with a generated id; never replay that id.
Off Days are saved in the order they were selected.
To read the Off Days options without changing data: open the list, read the .dx-list-item texts only, press Escape, then check there are still no new tags. Never click list items in a read-only case.
window.jQuery is not available on this screen: read the tag box from the DOM (.dx-tag, input value), not through a dxTagBox instance.
Update: the clickable inner #updateBtn sits below the fold (about 1300 px down); a real click scrolls to it. The watcher logs the wrapper #update.

Tab Demographics is #tab_2, but tab ids tab_1..tab_5 occur twice on the page (cent-tab wrapper and nested dx-button-content), so the same id can point at another tab: locate the tab by its text or with a class qualifier.
Report To (TXT__EPP1REPORTTO) is disabled on load when Sub Distributor = No (disabled=true, aria-disabled=true) and is shown red (invalid) until the first Update.

Clicking the same menu item again does not reset the screen (unsaved tags stay, the sidebar stays open over the grid). To reopen cleanly, reload the page and navigate again from the menu (a reload lands on Home).
The Distributor List grid shows only the distributor chosen at login. The code on the distributor selector is not always an HQ distributor code (some selections show 0 rows).
Off Days on Distributor Profile DT is the same tag box as on Distributor Profile HQ (#DDL__epp1_offdays).
Distributor Profile DT is not read-only: Update (#updateBtn, wrapper #update) saves Off Days directly, without approval, toast 'Updated successfully'.
Duplicate tab ids: tab_1 (cent-tab wrapper) and tab_2 (dx-button-content) both read Demographics; a real click on #tab_2 works.
Element ids change after Order Detail is clicked: PJPNO -> PJP, SELLCAT -> sellingCategory, SECTION -> Section, commentInput -> Comments, refNumberInput -> referenceNumber.
Outlet Name: type the outlet code, then pick the single filtered option at once. Typed text is discarded on blur if no option was picked, and a plain click in the long list can select the wrong row.

Order lines grid number cells (Order CS #quantity1_0, Order PC #quantity3_0): real click, select the cell content, type the digits, Tab (Tab goes CS -> PC; DZ is skipped and not editable). Clear-and-type goes stale because the row re-renders.

After Order Detail an empty edit row opens at the top; after each row Save the next edit row opens with the same ids (rowindex 1, #product, #quantity1_0, #rowEditBtn_Save_0) and saved rows move below with rowEditBtn_Edit_N / rowEditBtn_Delete_N.
Product (#product) is a type-ahead: type with real key events, wait for the list, then real-click the .dx-list-item. A product without stock answers 'Stock not available.' and clears the row.
The final Save (saveBtn) appears only after Validation (validateBtn); saving shows 'Validation successfully' and then 'Order Save successfully'.

Order Detail is a button (#orderDetail) that appears only after an Outlet is chosen; it is not a tab. New Order (#newOrder) asks 'Are You sure you want to cancel the order' (Yes = #continue resets the header, No = #reject).
Order Number is the input #documentNo; the summary amounts (Gross Amount, Discount, Tax, Net Amount) are plain text lines without ids.

Add, Save and Forward exist only on the Header Info tab. Switching back to Header Info after saving a line resets the header to a blank new form; reopen the DA from the grid (filter on Document No) before Forward.

Add a line with a real click on the grid toolbar .dx-datagrid-addrow-button. Row inputs: prodCode_0 (type-ahead: real keys, then a real click on the option), quantity1_0 (CS); row save rowEditBtn_Save_0. Stock type and batch fill automatically: type the quantity only after they have filled.
The Forward popup Save is the dx-button inside div#forwardPopUpSaveBtn; the #save inside it duplicates the id of the main Save.
The grid row filter (gridFilterCheckbox + Document No) stays set after approval and after reopening the screen; check aria-checked before toggling it.
After Add the form resets with Warehouse, Vendor Code and DA Type empty; Save with DA Type empty does nothing (no toast, only an inline invalid mark).
Loss entry: the '+' in the Loss cell (row in edit mode) opens a modal; its row save is rowEditBtn_Modal_Save_0; closing the modal with the x discards the loss.
Grid row Save/Edit links must be scrolled into view before a click (otherwise 'element not interactable').
The form Status stays 'Draft' after Forward until a reload; read the Approval Status from the grid instead.

The Detail tab (tab_3) is disabled for a few seconds after a GIN is opened. Switching back to the Header tab blanks the header (GIN number empty) and Forward exists only on the Header tab: forward on a freshly reopened GIN without switching tabs.
A typed Date To is not always committed (Refresh then answers "Required parameter 'toDate' is not present."); pick the date from the calendar popup.
The grid row filter stays set when the screen is reopened; the grid is not sorted by serial; the breadcrumb can show stale tab names.
Mark Status and DSR Files Status are blank in the grid and become dropdowns only in row Edit mode.
The result grid is paged (15 rows per page) and the products of interest can be on later pages: use the pager or a product filter. Type Balance Date with real key events and Enter.

The header is an editable grid: click the cell, then type into the generated input (code_0, description_0, startDate_0, endDate_0, entityType_0, subType_0); dropdown lists open only on a second click on the input. 'Scheme' is a plain button without id, not a tab. The promotion list has no search box and is paged.
Tab ids tab_1..tab_5 are duplicated (cent-tab wrapper and nested dx-button-content); the watcher reports tab_2 for Demographics.
Masked Cell Phone inputs read back with a trailing mask underscore (e.g. '60624091013_'); strip mask characters before comparing.
The row-open control #btn_1 carries its id on the icon element: click it by id btn_1 (a css '#btn_1 .dx-icon-spindown' click times out).
After Forward the grid still shows In-Active (also after reload) until the Checker approves; reopen the screen to read a new status.
The Forward popup Save has its stable id #forwardPopUpSaveBtn on the parent cent-button (the watcher logs the inner button without id). After approval the DSR leaves the DSR Approval list.
A row with an Edit link is not settled; a row without it is settled. Ignore the row colours.
Mapping saves show no toast; verify the mapped grid instead.
Mapping saves show no toast; verify the mapped grid instead.
On load the screen shows "Required parameter 'pjpNo' is not present." ('PJP not found'): a known issue, never assert it.
The result of Process (daily route and outlets due that day) is visible only after a full page reload.

Report To.disable_rule: Disabled and not required while Sub Distributor = No; enabled when Sub Distributor = Yes (the distributor then reports to a parent distributor).
